title: juicy fatty australian turkey ham bowl
description: a hearty one-pot dish featuring turkey ham, vegetables, and a crispy bottom crust.
instructions: heat the vegetable broth in a dolsot-stone-bowl over medium-high heat until simmering.
add the turkey ham, carrots, celery, onion, and garlic, and cook for 2 minutes.
add the potatoes, tomato, soy sauce, sugar, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 15 minutes.
while the mixture is cooking, prepare the egg whites and cornstarch for spherification.
when the mixture is done cooking, remove it from the heat and let it cool slightly.
use a spoon to create small wells in the mixture, then pour the egg whites and cornstarch mixture into each well.
return the dolsot-stone-bowl to the stovetop over medium heat and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the egg whites are set and the bottom crust is crispy.
serve the juicy fatty australian turkey ham bowl hot, garnished with additional soy sauce and sugar if desired.
let the bowl sit for 1-2 minutes to allow the spherified egg whites to set and the flavors to meld together before serving.
note: the cooking time may vary depending on the size and type of dolsot-stone-bowl used.

to ensure the egg whites are cooked through, check for doneness by cutting into one of the spherified egg white balls - if it is still runny, continue cooking for an additional 1-2 minutes and checking again.
do not overcook the egg whites, as they will become tough and rubbery.
